run: the روی check: does the kasra the app writes on the preposition روی (رویِ) make OmniVoice say it wrong
status: registered 2026-10-04, before any front-end ran on these sentences and before any render
why: in step 3 روی with the app's written ezafe was marked wrong in 11 of 12 readings across three sentences, in every form; the listener noted it said royi. In step 2 the one رویِ was heard right. No plain form was rendered in step 3, so whether the kasra causes it is open

sentences.written_by: Claude, 2026-10-04: روی as the preposition 'on' before a noun phrase - it takes the ezafe, ru-ye - in ten everyday contexts, two sentences with it twice

forms.R1: what the app sends OmniVoice today, at its default settings: the tagger's ezafe (رویِ) and Homo-GE2PE's homograph first vowels
forms.R0: R1 with the kasra taken off every روی that carries one, and nothing else changed

rendering: as step 3: one Kaggle T4 x2 session through the app's render script with its normaliser for OmniVoice and nothing added, seed 42, mana_000.wav, 10 x 2 = 20 renders, CER after the worker is released; held-out similarity after
review: as step 3: the plain sentence, two readings in Latin-square slots (each form five times in each slot), loudness matched, the key off the page; words to tap, a note, the better reading

decision_rule.primary: the times روی itself is marked wrong in each form, of 12
decision_rule.rule: the app stops writing the kasra on روی if R0 has روی marked wrong fewer times than R1 and R0's words marked wrong in all (of 114) are not more than R1's; otherwise it keeps writing it. A tie keeps it
decision_rule.harm: R0 is flagged and not adopted without the user's say if its mean CER is more than 2 points above R1's, or if its paired held-out similarity difference has a 95% bootstrap interval wholly below zero

not_claimed: one listener, one voice, one seed, 12 روی; other words ending in ی are not tested
cost: Kaggle: one session, about 0.2 GPU-hours; listening about 8 minutes

listening.when: 2026-10-04, blind, on the published page https://claude.ai/artifact/DnBHQbqRWXLt2innub42uo; all 10 sentences, every reading answered, a note on 14 of 20
listening.listener: recorded as پارسا. Steps 1 to 3 were heard by احمدرضا; the registration says one listener, not which
listening.answers: the page's database kept only an empty start (10:28 UTC, under احمدرضا: eval/runs/evidence/rui-review-v1/database-at-reading.json); the answers came as the page's answer code, pasted by the user in chat (answers-listener-1.json, its source field)

result.when: 2026-10-04; renders from its Kaggle session (every gate passed), read by scripts/read_rui_check.py, written before anyone listened
result.decision_by_the_registered_rule: R0 has روی wrong 0 times against R1's 1, and 11 words wrong against 12: the app stops writing the kasra on روی. CER -0.70 points, the similarity interval not wholly below zero: not flagged. Adopted

read_beside_it_not_used_for_the_decision.how_much: one mark decides it: r03's روی in R1, noted said roy (رُی). Every other word was marked the same in both forms, and no reading was picked over the other: to this listener the kasra on روی made almost no difference, and the rule needed only one mark
read_beside_it_not_used_for_the_decision.against_step_3: in step 3 the earlier listener marked the app's رویِ wrong in 11 of 12 readings (noted royi); here this listener marked it wrong in 1 of 12 in R1, on other sentences. A different listener and different sentences, and this check cannot say which made the difference
read_beside_it_not_used_for_the_decision.ezafe_the_model_added: four words were heard with an ezafe that neither form had written, the same in both: باران before گوش (r01), پیرمرد before هر (r06), حیاط before نقاشی (r03), and دیوار before باغ را (r10), where the tagger was right to give none. The same kind of error as the user's تعاملات معمولاً, which step 3's sukun did not stop
read_beside_it_not_used_for_the_decision.other_words: heard wrong in both forms: زانویش (noted زانوییش), بشقابش (بِشقاب, e for o), طاقچه and نیمکت with a vowel added inside (طاقِچه, نیمِکَت), می‌نشیند without its last a, پنجهٔ پا said panj-e with a pause (the هٔ ezafe of a silent h), and دیوار in r03 (noted دیوارِی in R0)

result.label: one listener, one voice, one seed, 12 روی
